## Description

**Observed on `staging` (2026-11-10; source-backed, pending browser reproduction):** New Project / Project Settings `Existing Locations` renders a Web Agent `SelectTrigger` with the default single-line 32px control while adjacent Directory `Textarea` has `min-h-11` (44px) plus two content rows. Their Web parent uses `sm:items-end`, causing differently sized controls to bottom-align. The same form uses locally composed `gap` / `rounded` / `border` treatments rather than an approved same-row field recipe.

This is **not** a request to repeat #3089's dialog width, long Select record, App operation-page, or #3128 sticky-footer repairs, which have already been accepted. The uncovered invariant is **same-row field hierarchy, top alignment and consistent control baseline** in the production Project form. #3089's later prototype exploration intentionally used matched single-line Agent/Directory geometry while the actual production textarea retained a separate layout choice; the prototype was explicitly not production pixel-parity evidence.

## Reproduction

1. Open Web → Projects → New Project or Project settings → add an Existing Location, at 1440px or 1180px.
2. Compare the top edges and heights of Agent Select vs Directory textarea (including a short path and a wrapped long path). Inspect computed `getBoundingClientRect()` and alignment in the actual React fixture.
3. Repeat at 1024px and narrow forced-Web; inspect the same row's width, overflow, label alignment and scroll ownership.
4. Confirm App at 390px / 375px remains a stacked, readable operation form rather than inheriting desktop row geometry.

**Verified source pointers:** `web/src/product/project/components/ProjectLocationsEditor.tsx` (`AgentField`, `PathField`, `LocationRows`), `web/src/components/ui/select.tsx`, `web/src/components/ui/textarea.tsx`. Browser screenshot/computed-style capture has **not** yet been performed for this post-#3089 finding.

## Root Cause

The production row composes independent primitive defaults (32px Select / 44px-min multiline Textarea) and consumer-local `sm:items-end`. The controls are valid individually but have no shared *same-row field alignment* decision in the product's current form recipe. Existing acceptance checked legibility/reflow/overflow and prototype publication, not this relational visual invariant.

## Impact

An otherwise functional Project editor appears assembled from unrelated control styles. Different row contents alter field alignment, reducing perceived hierarchy and repeatability. The same problem can recur in Session / Sandbox configuration if each consumer independently decides field geometry.

## Fix Direction

- Choose one explicit **Web form-row visual rule**: same label baseline / top alignment; matching compact field geometry when content is single-line; Directory may grow vertically for multiline content without dragging another control to its bottom.
- Implement the decision at the narrowest reusable owner (existing primitive semantic variant or a small product form-row recipe); avoid new global form/layout DSL and avoid overriding all Selects/Textareas.
- Preserve long-path wrapping, keyboard/focus/accessibility, dynamic locations, single scroll owner, and #3089 Web/App experience distinction.
- Ensure App uses its existing stacked/full-height `AppProjectFormSurface` and touch floor.
- Sync the **existing** #3089 `session-operation-surfaces-3089` prototype (do not create a competing mock). The prior prototype is a historical design reference until updated and reverified.

## Location

`web/src/product/project/components/ProjectLocationsEditor.tsx`; `web/src/product/project/components/ProjectFormFields.tsx`; `web/src/components/ui/{select,textarea}.tsx`. Design owner: `docs/design/design-system/components.md` and the shared Configuration Form recipe proposed in the sibling Capability UI consistency requirement.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] SC-01 In real production Chromium at Web 1440/1180/1024 with short and wrapped Existing Location paths, Agent and Directory labels/field starts align according to one documented row rule; the single-line control baseline is consistent, long text stays visible without horizontal form overflow, and the dialog retains a single intended scroll owner.
- [ ] SC-02 At App 390/375 and landscape, New Project / Settings remain stacked with one host-owned Back and action footer, accessible touch targets and no horizontal overflow; editing/removing locations preserves draft and focus behavior.
- [ ] SC-03 The existing #3089 prototype is revised **in place**, with the same approved Web/App field geometry and representative short/long/offline paths, and its source SHA / Pages manifest / executable Chromium click-through are verified without claiming mock equals production acceptance.

### SC → scenario and verifier

- **SC-01/02 → SCN-02 (Chromium Web/App):** approved source-aligned `type: browser` Cases / relevant existing Playwright regression specs on exact PR SHA; real production React fixture, computed top edges/field bounding boxes/wrapping, keyboard/touch and scrolling states. A screenshot aids comparison but cannot replace relational assertions.
- **SC-03 → SCN-08 (artifact/prototype):** source-pinned `prototype` orphan-tree HTML + gallery + trusted Pages manifest readback and Chromium mock journey, using the repository's existing artifact proof lane. No fabricated publication or visual-parity claim.

## Acceptance Plan

```yaml
acceptance:
  SC-01:
    when: pr
    method: case
  SC-02:
    when: pr
    method: case
  SC-03:
    when: pr
    method: case
```

| SC-01 | Pending | Production browser Case on exact PR SHA required |
| SC-02 | Pending | App browser Case on exact PR SHA required |
| SC-03 | Pending | Updated immutable prototype source + trusted Pages/Chromium proof required |

## Prototype

- **Decision:** Required — existing #3089 visual prototype must be updated, not duplicated.
- **Existing preview:** https://bestnathan.github.io/nession/prototypes/session-operation-surfaces-3089/index.html
- **Status:** Existing prototype is a reference, **not proof of this new field-alignment decision**. Update `prototype/session-operation-surfaces-3089/` and pin newly verified source/publication evidence when delivered.

## E2E Verification

### New

- none: extend existing browser specs and issue-owned Cases for this focused visual relationship; avoid another overlapping regression suite.

### Regression

- project-management
- project-session-create
- app-session-operations

## Product alignment

- [x] Keeps work dominant, respects Web/App experience distinctions and `PRINCIPLE.md` precision-over-decoration.
- [x] Reuses existing shadcn and Nession-owned recipes before adding visual abstractions.
- [x] Reviewed `docs/design/visual-language.md`, `design-system/components.md`, `interaction/{web,app}.md` and #3089/#3128. No new permanent chrome or business semantic change.

### Knowledge Impact

- Decision: Update
- Related knowledge: `docs/design/design-system/components.md` and future shared Configuration Form pattern, existing #3089 prototype.
- Reason: Establish the missing relational visual invariant for same-row configuration controls without changing Project domain behavior.
- Owner and timing: Web/design-system owner during implementation, alongside browser Cases and prototype update.
- Evidence: This source-based review; subsequent exact-SHA browser Case and revised prototype publication.

**Related:** #3089, #3128, #3025, #1451, #774.
